payload.title: Continue a reusable alternate desktop-control path
payload.goal: Advance an independently usable fallback available to both agents, with one active desktop operator and a bounded ability to diagnose or repair the primary path. The newly working local relay does not remove this goal.
payload.request: Please identify the current alternate UI controller, Aurum/Windows-MCP or existing SSH-bridge source/test status, exact artifact revision and active owner. Which existing candidate and supported ingress can we reuse next? Distinguish file/shell access from proven window observation, mouse and keyboard control. Return the smallest source/test step and any required later qualification or owner-only setup.
payload.coordination: Reuse existing reviewed work rather than building another competing stack. Coordinate design, source and offline tests first, preserve explicit ownership and exclusive desktop handoff, and map shared dependencies that could disable both routes.
payload.limits: No automatic installation, activation, new persistent access, security changes or credential sharing. Such changes still require their specific approval. Do not send private source, connection values, host identifiers or secrets in this public reply.
payload.reply_expectation: One substantive response may cover this and the preceding recovery/project update; no acknowledgment-only loop.
